title: Reading Drill — Comparing cameras at a nature hide — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing cameras at a nature hide — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The volunteer observer in Ravensmere received an old report about moving birds being missed at the edge of the image. The report compared the number of usable clips, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the recording samples rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered nine weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include activity at different tides. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a wider field of view as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
